s1.text:
The corridor is a carnival gone wrong. Lights flicker between colors. The floor tilts — or maybe it doesn't. Hard to tell in the Trickster's domain.

Three doors, each painted a different color. The red one buzzes with static. The blue one whispers. The gold one laughs.

"Pick a door," says a voice from everywhere. "Or don't. I'll pick for you."
s1.imagePrompt: A surreal carnival corridor with flickering multicolored lights, tilting floor, three painted doors - red buzzing with static, blue whispering mist, gold with a laughing face, chaotic dark fantasy
s1.ascensionText: You've been here before. The doors have swapped colors since last time — the Trickster knows you know.

choices.text: Blue door — listen to the whispers
Gold door — play the Trickster's game

s2a.text:
The room beyond makes sense — barely. A gambling den, suspended over nothing. Cards float in mid-air. Dice roll on invisible tables.

The Trickster's playbook is written on the cards. It copies moves. It mirrors strategies. The only way to beat a mirror is to be unpredictable.
s2a.imagePrompt: A surreal gambling den suspended over a void, floating cards and self-rolling dice on invisible tables, chaotic magical energy, dark fantasy trickster's lair

choices.text: Study the cards — learn what the Trickster copies
Scatter the cards — deny it information

s2b.text:
The door was a trick. Of course it was. You're in a maze now, reflections of yourself staring back from every angle — but each one is slightly wrong. One is faster. One is stronger. One is smiling.

"Having fun?" the voice asks.

You need to get out of here before the reflections get ideas.
s2b.imagePrompt: A maze of mirrors showing distorted reflections of the viewer, each slightly different - one faster, one stronger, one smiling wrongly, disorienting and sinister, dark fantasy

choices.text: Smash through the mirrors — raw force
Close your eyes and feel for the exit
Slip between the reflections — you know this trick

s3.text:
The arena is a stage. Spotlights. Curtains. An audience of shadows that applaud at random.

The Trickster stands center stage, bowing to no one. It wears your face — poorly, like a mask that doesn't quite fit.

"Ready for the show?"
s3.imagePrompt: A theatrical stage arena with spotlights and curtains, shadow audience applauding, a trickster figure wearing a poorly-fitting mask of the viewer's face, surreal dark fantasy

choices.text: Ignore the theatrics — fight, don't act
Your Trickster instincts see through the entire performance
Be completely random — out-chaos the chaos

s4_final.text:
The Trickster drops your face and shows its own — shifting, impossible, grinning with too many teeth.

"Probability is just a suggestion."
s4_final.imagePrompt: A trickster entity dropping a mask to reveal a shifting impossible face with too many teeth grinning, spotlight from above, chaotic energy swirling, dark fantasy boss encounter
s4_final.ascensionText: The Trickster's grin falters. "Oh. You're the one who figured it out. Fine — new tricks this time."
